title: Unravelling the potential of Vitex negundo leaf extract in LPS-induced acute lung injury in mice through modulation of the TLR-4/NF-kappaB p65/iNOS pathway: Insights from integrated phytochemical characterization, in silico, and in vivo analysis.
authors: Meena, Mamta; Sharma, Meemansha; S, Ilavarasan; Mishra, Anand Mohan; Sharma, Anshuk; V A, Aneesha; Lingaraju, Madhu Cholenahalli; Parida, Subhashree; Singh, Vidya; Chandra, Vikash; Singh, Mausam; Shanker, Karuna; Panwar, Jitendra; Singh, Thakur Uttam
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物对急性肺损伤的抗炎作用，涉及TLR-4/NF-kB/iNOS通路及分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Vitex negundo L. is a traditionally used medicinal plant with documented anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. Although previous studies have demonstrated its efficacy in allergic asthma, its protective potential in acute lung injury (ALI) remains unexplored. The present study aimed to investigate the effects and underlying molecular mechanism of Vitex negundo L. leaf extract (VNE) against lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced acute lung injury in mice model. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Phytochemical characterization of VNE was performed using High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC), Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), and Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR). Hematological, biochemical, histopathological, cytokine, and molecular analysis, along with in silico docking studies, were conducted to assess the protective effects of VNE on LPS-induced lung injury. RESULTS: GC-MS and FTIR confirmed the presence of diverse phytoconstituents, whereas HPLC identified agnuside as a major bioactive compound. VNE effectively mitigated LPS-induced pathological alterations and pulmonary edema. It significantly reduced WBC and lymphocyte counts, C-reactive protein, LDH, pro-inflammatory cytokines, and myeloperoxidase activity, while restoring antioxidant markers and decreasing malondialdehyde content. VNE also downregulated TLR-4 mRNA expression and reduced iNOS and NF-kappaB p65 protein levels, suggesting inhibition of the TLR-4/NF-kappaB p65/iNOS signaling pathway. Molecular docking demonstrated strong binding affinity of agnuside with TLR-4, NF-kappaB p65, and iNOS through hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interactions, supporting its ability to inhibit these key inflammatory mediators. CONCLUSION: VNE exerts potent protective effects against LPS-induced ALI by modulating TLR-4/NF-kappaB p65/iNOS signaling pathway, validating its ethnopharmacological relevance and therapeutic potential in lung inflammatory disorders.
abstract_zh: 背景：黄荆（Vitex negundo L.）是一种传统药用植物，具有已记载的抗炎、抗氧化和免疫调节特性。尽管先前研究已证明其对过敏性哮喘的疗效，但其在急性肺损伤（ALI）中的保护潜力尚未被探索。本研究旨在探讨黄荆叶提取物（VNE）对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的小鼠急性肺损伤的作用及其潜在分子机制。材料与方法：采用高效液相色谱（HPLC）、气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）对VNE进行植物化学表征。通过血液学、生化、组织病理学、细胞因子和分子分析，以及计算机模拟对接研究，评估VNE对LPS诱导肺损伤的保护作用。结果：GC-MS和FTIR确认了多种植物成分的存在，而HPLC鉴定出agnuside为主要生物活性化合物。VNE有效缓解了LPS诱导的病理改变和肺水肿。它显著降低了白细胞和淋巴细胞计数、C反应蛋白、乳酸脱氢酶、促炎细胞因子和髓过氧化物酶活性，同时恢复抗氧化标志物并降低丙二醛含量。VNE还下调了TLR-4 mRNA表达，并降低iNOS和NF-kappaB p65蛋白水平，表明其抑制了TLR-4/NF-kappaB p65/iNOS信号通路。分子对接显示，agnuside通过氢键和疏水相互作用与TLR-4、NF-kappaB p65和iNOS具有强结合亲和力，支持其抑制这些关键炎症介质的能力。结论：VNE通过调节TLR-4/NF-kappaB p65/iNOS信号通路，对LPS诱导的ALI发挥强效保护作用，验证了其在肺部炎症性疾病中的民族药理学相关性和治疗潜力。
